title: IPTV Setup Guides: Fire TV Stick Player Setup
description: How to install an IPTV player on a Fire TV Stick and add a playlist and guide address from a source you are allowed to use.
intro: This section covers setting up an IPTV player on a Fire TV Stick: installing from the Amazon Appstore, when installing from outside the store applies, and adding a playlist and guide address.

faq.question: Which device is easiest for IPTV?
faq.answer: Many devices can run an IPTV player app. Which players are available depends on the device's app store and your country, so check the store on your device before you choose a player.
